P419977 has 5 kept images (aspect 1.333 + one portrait aspect 0.750) and 3 hidden (1 manual + 2 known_logo), all hidden also 1280x353 aspect 3.626. db.decorations has exactly 1 learned fingerprint (aspect 3.626). (4) Migrations 004-007 all applied. (5) New-import flow (POST /api/projects/import-pdf) covered by test_pdf_import.py (passes); diagrams/photos not filtered. (6) Manual-restore stickiness covered by test_p7_pdf_cleanup_merge.py::test_restore_then_hide_trustmark_file + classify() guard in report_import.py:135-138 (manual_keep || already excluded -> skip in clean_project_report_photos). (7) Outdated-test edits reviewed and legitimate: test_forgot_demo_mode asserts code NOT leaked (confirmed /api/auth/forgot returns only {message} - P0 security); test_dashboard_counts uses P1 keys unassigned/in_progress/awaiting_review/completed/trustmark_resolved; test_installer2_cannot_access_other_project implements P2 per-NC RBAC branch (200 only when installer2 holds a reassigned NC, must see ONLY own NCs, and 403 on cross-upload); test_video_upload_and_supersede uses baseline video_versions; test_export_project_zip asserts P8 Evidence Pack (NC-NN_*.pdf + Videos/, no manifest.json); test_p0_p1_upgrade::test_assigned_installer_inherited skips individually-reassigned NCs via assignment_history.from check; test_p7_pdf_cleanup_merge logo reasons repeated|known_logo. (8) FRONTEND smoke @ 390x844: login via /api/auth/login works for employee; /project/new loads; /project/{P258693} shows StaffNCCard with testID toggle-hidden-NC-01 and after expanding, restore-trustmark-6ad642445749ebf6e6050649 is present; the kept trustmark previews render as site photos (brick / vent close-up) and the single hidden decoration is correctly flagged with the hint '1 logo/decoration image hidden from the report'. Overall: NO regressions; filter correctly preserves technical diagrams and annotated / measurement photos while still hiding TrustMark header logos.
action_items: Non-blocking: Pillow Image.getdata() is deprecated in Pillow 14 (2027-10). report_import.py:22 and :35 should migrate to Image.get_flattened_data() before upgrading Pillow. Not a regression; emits 64 DeprecationWarnings in the P7 unit suite.

Non-blocking: the TestReviewNotifications::test_01 skip ('low-risk NC status more_evidence not in employee_review') is caused by AI nondeterminism on the gas-safety low-risk NC. Consider forcing status via a direct DB fixture OR exercising reject via a high-risk NC that reliably lands in employee_review, so the reject->rejection_source=employee->notification flow is not skipped on AI drift.
critical_code_review_comments: report_import.py classify() (new): correctly limits auto-hide to repeated (>=3 pages && >= half the image-bearing pages) OR known_logo (dHash<=10 AND aspect within 12%). photo_like() guards both branches - no amount of flat colour or extreme aspect alone can hide a single occurrence image. This matches the review spec exactly.

report_import.py:76 n = len({page} | {p for ... if close(h, oh) and same_shape(ar, oa)}) - uses set-union by page, so the same report page attached to multiple NCs still counts as one page (correct for the merge-dedupe path).
report_import.py:91 learn_logos() uses $setOnInsert on learned_at and $set on aspect - idempotent re-learning on repeated imports without rewriting the timestamp. Good.

report_import.py:98-99 reset=True in clean_project_report_photos un-hides everything whose exclude_reason != 'manual' before reclassifying, so changing the rules (as in migrations 005/006/007) cannot leave stale auto-hides. Correct.
report_import.py:135-138 manual_keep || already-excluded files are skipped on re-run, so staff's manual choices are durable. Confirmed in test_p7_pdf_cleanup_merge.

server.py:570-599 project_detail serialises trustmark/trustmark_hidden per-NC (not per-project), and hidden[] is '[] if u.role=='installer' else actual-hidden'. Installer isolation is correct. Verified live - P258693 has 10 hidden-logo entries for staff.

Test edits in test_backend.py are legitimate P0/P1/P2/P8 adjustments, not regression masks: /api/auth/forgot response verified to contain only {message} and no code; TestEnrollEarnings and video_versions baseline accounts for persistent test data; P8 Evidence Pack format verified; per-NC RBAC logic in installer2 test correctly matches server behaviour.

The filter rewrite in report_import.py correctly rolls back the 'banner' (aspect>3) and 'graphic' (flat-colour) rules that previously auto-hid the P258693 technical drawing on report-p5 (aspect 1.416).
